final_text:
I found Mike Dunn from Ledgerly Books (the bookkeeping firm) with the email mike@ledgerlybooks.test. He is a guest user in our organization.

Since you want to give Mike access to the billing mailbox, I need to determine what type of access you want to grant. Here are your options:

1. Full Read Access - Can read and manage emails but NOT send as the mailbox owner
2. Full Read Access + Send As - Can read/manage emails AND send emails as the mailbox owner
3. Full Read Access + Send on Behalf - Can read/manage emails AND send emails on behalf of the mailbox owner
4. Full Permissions - All three permissions (Read + Send As + Send on Behalf)

Please let me know which option you prefer.
